source: foundation/BACKLOG-UX.md — vue pellicule compacte présentant tous les presets QR simultanément
objective: Create a DOM-free QR Studio filmstrip presentation adapter that exposes all system presets simultaneously, synchronizes selection/navigation with QRStudioSession, delegates filmstrip navigation to FilmstripController and surfaces edit/dirty/validated/generation preview states without generating QR or styling the UI.

coordination.qr_session: QRStudioSession #91 remains the workflow source of truth and is consumed through its public API only.
coordination.filmstrip_controller: FilmstripController remains the generic navigation source of truth and is consumed without modification.
coordination.qr_generation: QRWiz remains the QR generator; previews come only from session generation results or an injected preview adapter.
coordination.agent_d: DataJoinCompositeKeyMatcher is integrated before reservation and does not overlap.
coordination.parallel: ResponsivePreview/TableWiz review scopes remain disjoint and untouched.
coordination.human: No CSS, visual calibration or demo wiring in this lot.

notes: No QRStudioSession, QRStudioSchema, FilmstripController, QRWiz, CSS, demo or roadmap canonical files modified.
